A safe link keeps its address.

A relative link keeps its address too.

An in-page link points at a heading on this page.

A hostile link loses its address and keeps its text.

A second hostile link loses its address as well.

A file link is not a thing a page may offer.

The sentence survives even though the destinations do not, which is the point: a GM whose sync pulled in a hostile link wants the prose to still read.
